Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Lumina
Message:
feat: sk_pqc v0.1.0 — hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM-768 KEM (web + native)

Sovereign OSS Flutter/Dart package: hybrid post-quantum key encapsulation,
suite `x25519-mlkem768` (FIPS 203 ML-KEM-768 + X25519), one HybridKem API with
two backends behind a conditional import.

- native (dart:ffi)        → liboqs OQS_KEM ML-KEM-768 (proven on Linux desktop)
- web    (dart:js_interop)  → @noble/post-quantum ml_kem768 (compiles via dart2js)
- X25519 leg via package:cryptography (DHKEM-style ephemeral-static) on both
- combiner (the ONLY original crypto): HKDF-SHA256(X25519_ss ‖ MLKEM768_ss, salt, info)

Wire format documented as the interop contract: pk 1216B, sk 2432B, ct 1120B,
ss 32B (X25519 part first, then ML-KEM-768).

Correctness:
- ML-KEM-768 KAT anchored to NIST ACVP FIPS 203 keyGen (seed d‖z, tcId 26)
- combiner KATs incl. RFC 5869 §A.1
- cross-backend: noble ↔ liboqs both directions agree
- emitted JSON interop vector verified by Dart, liboqs, noble, and Python
  (tool/verify_vector.py) — the contract pqkem.py (Q1) must match
- round-trip + malformed-input handling (SkPqcError, implicit rejection)

Honest README: hybrid (secure if EITHER primitive holds), FIPS 203 -768 tier,
web assurance depends on noble, KEM-only (signatures future). No "quantum-proof".

OSS-ready: Apache-2.0, README, CHANGELOG, example/. `dart analyze` clean,
`dart test` 15/15 green, `dart pub publish --dry-run` 0 warnings.

Coord: 88300251 (epic PQC-MIGRATION e1d6ba2a).
